title: Alignment-Maintained Discount on Workmanship Shares — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
An alignment-maintained discount is taken off the prorated share of a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty workmanship share, following the vehicle's plan under Alignment Services & Plans and the latest alignment performed on that plan.

| Plan on the vehicle | Latest performed alignment | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| active lifetime alignment plan (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan, Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance) | fewer than 12 months before the replacement visit | 15% of the prorated share off |
| active Crestline 1-Year or 3-Year Alignment Plan | fewer than 12 months before the replacement visit | 10% of the prorated share off |
| any other vehicle | — | nothing off |

The age of the alignment is counted in whole calendar months from the alignment date to the replacement visit (the date of the inspection entry that records the defect). Every part taken off the prorated share is a percentage of the prorated share worked out on its own; together they never take the workmanship share percentage below 0.

**Both sides (hypothetical lifetime plan):** alignment 11 whole months before the visit — 15% off; 12 whole months before — nothing off.
